next.reason: §2023:14.9.48.4 GR9 repeats both 1985 sentences ('When a delimiter contains two or more characters, all of the characters shall be present in contiguous positions of the sending item', 'must' becoming 'shall'). Its zero-length additions reach no 1985 program 2023 accepts. GR3 ('specifies a delimiter') is a separate statement of a different 1985 rule.
